$schema: EvidenceLine Nebius integration contract — hand to Person B (Shresth)
description: Person C analyzes one incident photo + transcript context. Called from InsForge edge function analyze-incident.

request.raw_transcript: string — voice summary of what caller reported
request.image: string — public HTTPS URL OR base64 data URI (data:image/jpeg;base64,...)

hazard_evidence: string — specific visible facts, e.g. dented rear bumper

example_request.raw_transcript: I was rear-ended at a stop light. I'm okay but my rear bumper is damaged.

hazard_evidence: visible dent and scuffing on rear bumper
missing_evidence: other vehicle license plate not visible
no wide shot of intersection or surrounding area

field_mapping_to_incidents_table.matches_description: store in hazard_evidence meta or separate column if added
field_mapping_to_incidents_table.confidence: optional — can omit from DB for MVP
